name: PSX Modular Humans — 6 free rigged low-poly retro characters (GLB + FBX)
summary: Six PS1-style low-poly humans (913–1,035 tris each) with casual, sporty and office outfits and props, each split into swappable meshes on one 18-bone FK rig and one 128×128 pixel-art atlas. GLB and FBX with embedded textures, plus PNG previews and an import guide. Good for PSX horror, retro RPG NPCs and game jams. No animation clips (rest pose).

access.notes: Use in personal and commercial projects, no attribution needed; no resale or redistribution of the files as standalone assets. itch page is tagged AI-assisted / AI graphics.

procedure: Open the itch.io page and click Download Now
On the name-your-price screen choose 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads'
Import the GLB or FBX from Export/; keep Nearest/Point texture filtering for the PSX look

verdict.why: Clean, rigged, free-for-commercial PSX characters with a proper license file; small pack, no animations, and itch flags AI assistance.
